Comparisons with the role of the pre-T-cell receptor (pre-TCR) in T-cell development raise provocative questions. Why do B- and T-cell lineages both use a surrogate chain — the surrogate light chain and the pre-TCR α-chain, respectively — as a step to develop their repertoires of antigen-recognizing cells?
